```{r}
library(crcsim)
library(drpop)
```

# Quick Analysis

```{r}
set.seed(2024)
n_individuals <- 500
n_captures <- 6
p_captures <- c(0.45, 0.35, 0.25, 0.20, 0.4, 0.1)
covariate_df <- data.frame(
    distribution = c("uniform"),
    p1 = c(1),
    p2 = c(5),
    dtype = c("integer")
)

sim_data <- create_data(
    n_individuals = n_individuals,
    n_captures = n_captures,
    p_captures = p_captures,
    covariate_ranges = covariate_df
) |>
    all_int_cols_to_numeric() |>
    extract_captured_data(c(
        "capture_1", "capture_2", "capture_3",
        "capture_4", "capture_5", "capture_6"
    ))

qhat <- drpop::popsize(
    data = sim_data, funcname = c("logit"), nfolds = 2, margin = 0.005
)

psin_estimates <- drpop::popsize(
    data = sim_data, getnuis = qhat$nuis, idfold = qhat$idfold
)
```
